neighbours.label: Fires on the token that commits a clause to a present person's or group's standing background: prior tenure, roles or residence cast as present-relevant history (has/have worked, lived, served; previously worked; spent N years at; remember X from his time; familiar from my previous job) or a standing tie to another person (relationship to/with, a grandparent who), but not when the same verb narrates a dated event with no present frame, not on 'experience' as something a person brings to a role, and not on relationships between abstractions.
fire: Our new treasurer, Hannah Price, has previously worked as an auditor for two regional banks.
Nearly half of the shop's regular customers have lived on this street for more than thirty years.
On the form, describe your relationship to the patient and whether you hold power of attorney.
Mr. Okafor, who takes over as head in September, spent eleven years at a comprehensive school in Leeds.
Older supporters may still remember Keane from his two seasons in goal for the reserves.
Both of the incoming trustees have served on similar boards elsewhere in the health service.
Since the wedding, how would you describe your relationship with your father-in-law?
Several of the senior nurses have worked alongside Dr. Reyes at two other hospitals.
quiet: Last Tuesday, Hannah Price worked a twelve-hour shift reconciling the branch's accounts.
Most of the regulars at the corner shop have agreed to boycott the street market next week.
In the chart notes, record the relationship between the dosage and the patient's reported symptoms.
During the assembly, Mr. Okafor spent twenty minutes at the lectern reading out the prize list.
At the charity match next Saturday, Keane will greet the older supporters at the gate.
The two incoming trustees have asked for the hospital's accounts to be published before Friday's vote.
After the honeymoon, how often did you end up having dinner with your father-in-law?
Dr. Reyes says the senior nurses bring decades of experience to the new cardiac unit.
